The episode is set in a world that has been reconfigured to fit the wishes of Conrad Clark at the behest of the Rani, a long-time enemy of the Doctor. The episode involves the Doctor and Belinda arriving in a world that is vastly different from the one they know, where things are not as they seem.

The episode begins with the Doctor and Belinda arriving in a world that has been reconfigured to fit the wishes of Conrad Clark, a genius scientist. The world they find is a bizarre and surreal place, where the sky is clear, everyone seems to have a purpose, and there are no signs of the chaos and disorder that the Doctor is used to. However, as the episode progresses, it becomes clear that the world is not as perfect as it seems. The Doctor and Belinda soon discover that the world they are in is a trap, and that the Rani has used the power of the TARDIS to reconfigure the world to her own desires.

The main characters in the episode are the Doctor, Belinda, and the Rani. The Doctor is a time-traveling alien who has been traveling through time and space for centuries. Belinda is a young woman who has been traveling with the Doctor, and she is a skilled and resourceful companion. The Rani is a long-time enemy of the Doctor, and she is a powerful and manipulative character who is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve her goals.

"Wish World" has been well-received by fans of the show, with many praising the episode for its unique and surreal world-building. The episode has also been noted for its use of Easter eggs and references to other episodes of the show, which has been both praised and criticized by fans.
